description: Read the fault code off the single fault line a brick kiln controller recorded during a day's firing. DISTILL-CANARY-b04e89b6

files.README.md:
# Kilnhurst Brickworks - kiln controller journal

One line per zone reading or event. FAULT lines carry the manufacturer code
for the fault; readings are INFO lines and carry no codes.
